# Spartacus Educational

> > A comprehensive educational history resource covering military conflicts, political figures, and biographical research from WWI and WWII to the JFK assassination and Tudor England.

Spartacus Educational provides detailed historical references, biographical indexes, and critical book reviews across major periods of modern history. The site specializes in military history (particularly the World Wars), political figures, and historical controversies, serving students, researchers, and history enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Second World War
- First World War
- Battle of the Somme
- JFK assassination
- Warren Commission
- Military history
- British soldiers
- War poetry
- Biographical indexes
- Anthony Eden
- John F. Kennedy
- German scientists
- Tudor history
- Political figures
- Historical book reviews

## Second World War Resources

- [Second World War Battles](https://spartacus-educational.com/2WWbattles.htm): Index of major WWII battles and military engagements
- [Countries and the Second World War](https://spartacus-educational.com/2WWcountries.htm): Index of countries involved in WWII with historical overviews
- [Spartacus Review: Volume 29 - American Civil War](https://spartacus-educational.com/29REV2ww.htm): WWII book review on Waffen-SS and Muslim volunteers in Nazi Germany

## First World War Resources

- [Spartacus Review: Volume 1 - First World War](https://spartacus-educational.com/1REVfww.htm): WWI book reviews covering war poetry, Punch Magazine, and military history

## Political History and Figures

- [Spartacus Review: Volume 11 - John F. Kennedy](https://spartacus-educational.com/11REVjfk.htm): JFK assassination book reviews including Warren Commission criticism
- [Spartacus Review: Volume 2 - Modern Politics](https://spartacus-educational.com/2REVpolitics.htm): Political book reviews on Thatcher, Marx, and British political philosophy
- [French Politicial Figures: 1920-50](https://spartacus-educational.com/FRpol39.htm): Biographical index of French politicians from interwar to postwar period

## Biographical Indexes

- [German Scientists](https://spartacus-educational.com/GERscientists.htm): Biographical index of 24 German scientists including Einstein and von Braun
- [Laetitia Pilkington](https://spartacus-educational.com/18pilkington.htm): Biography of 18th-century Irish poet and memoirist Laetitia Pilkington

## Tudor and Medieval History

- [Tudor Portraits: Characters in Wolf Hall (TV Series)](https://spartacus-educational.com/Wolf_Hall2.htm): Character guide to Tudor figures in Wolf Hall TV series
- [Spartacus Review: Volume 19 - The Monachy](https://spartacus-educational.com/19REVmonarchy.htm): Book reviews on medieval monarchy including Henry IV and Richard II

## Optional

- [Spartacus Review: Volume 1 - Travel Writing](https://spartacus-educational.com/1REVtrav.htm): Travel writing book reviews covering British history and conservation
